description: The default audio bank (REQ-023 AC-5). Every cue and bed in the closed AudioEvent set has an entry here, so a world declaring no music or ambience falls back to these rather than to silence. A world may override any subset through the Level Contract; keys not overridden resolve to these paths.
assetLayout: Audio assets live under assets/audio/<category>/ per the Asset Contract (REQ-015), each with a provenance.json sidecar recording author, generation method and license terms. AI-generated audio additionally records the tool and prompt.
